kv_storage_estimate.assumption: F16 keys and values, one sequence slot; not total resident memory.

actual_prior_microbenchmark.scope: 512-token prefill/32-token decode microbenchmark process, not full-context server peak

limitations: Header metadata read independently from pinned immutable URL; full weights hash verification belongs to the retained CI asset receipt.
KV arithmetic excludes weights, compute buffers, application processes and Elasticsearch/Kibana memory.
No measured memory-capacity or multi-step quality claim; owned-process snapshots are recorded in subsequent actual execution.
